propositions: Cancelled ACLI link-delete commands (EOF on stdin when prompted, with stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL) are miscounted as applied links because the exception handler increments links_applied without validation, causing fabricated success reports and silent divergence.

The root cause is missing --yes flag on workitem link create and link delete subcommands, which causes ACLI to prompt for confirmation; this is an identical failure mode to bug 3256 already fixed for workitem delete.

Idempotent detection of concurrent removals must match both stderr AND stdout (not stderr alone) to avoid false-alarm failures when the 404/not-found marker appears on stdout, per the precedent in delete_issue.
The silent-divergence is undetectable by REBAR_RECONCILER_FAIL_SILENT_NOOP canary because it inflates links_applied to match computed, defeating the computed>0 and applied==0 alarm condition.
A new links_failed counter is required to distinguish real failures from idempotent races, reported in batch_outcome and visible to the silent-noop canary.
